digest.component_or_area: Container plan-review attestations and drift-scope inheritance
propositions: A live declared-none child must be neutral and not poison sibling path declarations or force whole-HEAD invalidation

Container scope classification must distinguish paths, none, and unscoped based on authenticated tri-state scope with exact precedence: own/cited/inherited paths override all-none children, which override undeclared poisoners
Cheap resign must preserve child-derived signed scope using immutable relation snapshot without network reads
P9 must pass leaves and containers with all live children declared, advising only live undeclared children with both path declaration and --none remedies
Mixed live paths and none children must sign only path dependencies and survive unrelated file drift while becoming stale on declared child path changes
